{{quote|I made enough for two, but marshwhite tea keeps longer than salted fish.  It works better the longer it sits, too, but it also grows more bitter.  Makes a race between how much you need your stomach settled and what your tongue can stand. Drink, girl.|[[Tairen]] [[Wise Woman]], [[Ailhuin Guenna|Mother Guenna]]{{ref/book|3|48}} }}
{{dablink|For other uses of the word "white," see [[White]].}}
'''Marshwhite''' is an [[herbs|herb]] that can be found in [[Tear]]. Its leaves can be brewed as a tea and administered to ease a queasy stomach. The tea works as well as [[chainleaf]] tea, though also has a bitter taste.{{ref/book|3|48}}
